summary: Accepted scoped reconciliation decision for cancelled roadmap code-path lint after web UI removal.

diff_table.current_project_state: Cancelled historic roadmap tasks such as TASK-012/TASK-036 retain code_paths that reference removed browser UI source, so roadmap lint routes them as active `roadmap-missing-code-path` reconciliation warnings.
diff_table.desired_state: Missing code-path lint applies to active/open roadmap tasks, while cancelled/non-open historic tasks are treated as evidence and do not block current reconciliation after validated source removal.
diff_table.agreed_change: Missing code-path lint applies to active/open roadmap tasks, while cancelled/non-open historic tasks are treated as evidence and do not block current reconciliation after validated source removal.
diff_table.expected_final_state: Missing code-path lint applies to active/open roadmap tasks, while cancelled/non-open historic tasks are treated as evidence and do not block current reconciliation after validated source removal.
